svg.title: Google Cloud · Global ingress still has regional dependencies
svg.desc: A global external Application Load Balancer sends traffic to a regional managed instance group. The drawing shows a regional slice of a global VPC. SQL traffic uses private services access to the Cloud SQL service network.
svg.text: Google Cloud · Global ingress still has regional dependencies
DEPLOYMENT VIEW / global HTTPS → regional MIG → Cloud SQL HA
Reserved range and private connection; SQL authentication is separate.
Regional MIG capacity can continue in another zone. Cloud SQL HA promotes the
standby and closes existing connections; clients reconnect. Load-balancer and
What does not survive a region loss
The global address remains, but this design has no second regional backend or
database recovery target. Global ingress is not a multi-region application.
Plan backups and test restore separately.
Solid arrows: labelled traffic or replication. Dashed arrows: policy/control. Conceptual design; assumptions and sources in the chapter.
